summary: Splash Beverage Group filed an 8-K on July 6, 2026, reporting entry into an Exclusive License Agreement with Argent Biopharma Limited. The filing discloses no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event. It is a routine disclosure of a material definitive agreement—a licensing deal for a pharmaceutical product—and does not involve a change of control, shareholder vote, or transaction subject to special-situations analysis. Therefore, it does not qualify under the specified categories.
